teams.description: Brand strategy, campaigns, content, influencer marketing, and retail marketing programs.

teams.name: Product Development
teams.description: New product ideation, formulation, packaging, regulatory, and go-to-market readiness.

teams.name: E-commerce & Digital
teams.description: BondCare.com, DTC e-commerce, SEO, paid digital, and platform operations.

teams.name: Sales & Revenue
teams.description: Retail accounts, salon professional channel, distributor partnerships, and revenue planning.

teams.name: Operations & Supply Chain
teams.description: Manufacturing, 3PL logistics, supply chain planning, and post-GlobalCorp integration operations.

projects.name: No. 9 Bond Protector Launch — Q4 2026
projects.notes: Full go-to-market launch of No. 9 Bond Protector across DTC, BeautyFirst, and GlowCo channels for Q4 2026. Includes product claims finalization, creative assets, influencer activation, and retail set-up.

projects.name: GlobalCorp Integration Workstream
projects.notes: Post-acquisition integration tasks following GlobalCorp's $1.4B acquisition of BondCare in 2026. Covers ERP alignment, legal entity restructuring, brand guidelines sync, and supply chain handover.

projects.name: Holiday Campaign 2026
projects.notes: Annual holiday marketing campaign covering gift sets, Black Friday/Cyber Monday promotions, influencer gifting, and in-store retail activations at GlowCo and BeautyFirst.

projects.name: New Product Development — Scalp Serum
projects.notes: Development of a new scalp care serum SKU targeting the prestige scalp health category. Includes consumer research, formulation, stability testing, packaging, and regulatory submission.

projects.name: E-commerce Platform Migration
projects.notes: Migration from legacy CommercePro infrastructure to a new enterprise e-commerce platform. Includes data migration, QA, SEO redirects, and post-launch monitoring.

projects.name: Salon Pro Partner Program Relaunch
projects.notes: Relaunch of the BondCare Professional salon partner program with updated portal UX, refreshed sales collateral, and outreach to top salon accounts in North America.

projects.name: Q4 Retail Sell-in
projects.notes: Q4 retail sell-in negotiations and submissions for major retail partners including HealthMart, Target, and GlowCo. Covers planogram submissions, endcap proposals, and promotional calendars.

projects.name: Supply Chain Optimization
projects.notes: Cross-functional initiative to reduce lead times, improve 3PL fulfillment accuracy, and consolidate packaging suppliers as part of the post-GlobalCorp integration efficiency drive.

tasks.name: Finalize product claims with legal
tasks.notes: Legal team needs to sign off on all No. 9 Bond Protector marketing claims before any assets are finalized. This includes packaging copy, PDP claims, and ad creative. FDA compliance and FTC guidelines must be checked.

tasks.name: Shoot hero product imagery
tasks.notes: Commission and shoot hero product imagery for No. 9 Bond Protector. Must include lifestyle shots, flat lay, and close-up detail. Studio booked for September 22. Provide creative brief to photographer by Sep 18.

tasks.name: Brief influencer partners on launch
tasks.notes: Send full launch brief to Tier 1 influencer partners. Include product seeding kits, key messages, embargo date (Oct 28), and content guidelines. Coordinate with PR agency on outreach list.

tasks.name: Submit PDP copy for review
tasks.notes: Draft and submit product detail page copy for No. 9 Bond Protector to the content review committee. Include headline, subhead, key benefits, how-to-use, and ingredient callouts. Must pass legal review before submission.

tasks.name: Set up BeautyFirst launch campaign
tasks.notes: Coordinate the BeautyFirst exclusive launch window for No. 9 Bond Protector. Includes co-op media brief, BeautyFirst.com PDP setup, Beauty Insider email inclusion, and in-store signage coordination with field team.

tasks.name: Align on shared ERP systems
tasks.notes: Facilitate joint workshop between BondCare IT and GlobalCorp IT to define ERP integration approach. Document current BondCare NetSuite configuration and map to GlobalCorp EnterpriseOne modules. Deliverable: integration decision brief by Oct 15.

tasks.name: Legal entity structure review
tasks.notes: Work with outside counsel and GlobalCorp legal to review BondCare's legal entity structure post-acquisition. Identify subsidiaries to be merged, dissolved, or retained. Target completion before year-end close.

tasks.name: Brand guidelines sync with GlobalCorp team
tasks.notes: Schedule working sessions with GlobalCorp brand team to align on co-branding guidelines. Define where GlobalCorp masterbrand appears on BondCare packaging, digital, and trade assets. BondCare brand independence is a key negotiation point.

tasks.name: Supply chain handover documentation
tasks.notes: Document all BondCare supply chain processes, key supplier contacts, lead times, and contractual obligations for GlobalCorp operations team handover. Includes No.3 Hair Perfector, No.4 Shampoo, and No.5 Conditioner production lines.

tasks.name: Holiday gift set packaging design
tasks.notes: Design packaging for the 2026 holiday gift set collection. Three SKUs planned: The Essential Strength Set, The Repair & Restore Kit, and The Salon Starter Bundle. Must align with holiday creative brief. Deadline for print-ready files: Oct 5.

tasks.name: Black Friday email sequence
tasks.notes: Build 5-email Black Friday/Cyber Monday sequence in Klaviyo. Includes teaser (Nov 25), launch day (Nov 27), extended sale (Nov 29), last chance (Dec 1), and cyber wrap-up (Dec 2). Segment by purchase history and loyalty tier.

tasks.name: Influencer gifting logistics
tasks.notes: Coordinate holiday gifting kits for 150 influencer partners. Kits include full holiday gift set plus handwritten note and brand lookbook. Work with fulfillment partner to ship by Nov 15. Budget: $45,000.

tasks.name: Retail display units for GlowCo
tasks.notes: Produce and ship 1,200 holiday endcap display units to GlowCo distribution centers. Coordinate with GlowCo merchant team on planogram specs and in-store set date (Nov 12). Vendor must deliver by Nov 5 to allow set-up time.

tasks.name: Consumer research synthesis
tasks.notes: Synthesize findings from Q2 scalp health consumer research study (n=600). Identify top unmet needs, ingredient preferences, price sensitivity, and competitive whitespace. Output: 10-slide insights deck for innovation brief.

tasks.name: Formula stability testing
tasks.notes: Run 12-week accelerated stability tests on top 3 scalp serum formula candidates. Test at 40°C/75%RH and ambient conditions. Report must confirm 24-month shelf life. Work with contract lab (Eurofins) for turnaround.

tasks.name: Packaging design concepts
tasks.notes: Brief design agency on scalp serum packaging. Produce 3 distinct concepts that align with BondCare brand system. Must accommodate 50ml and 100ml formats. Review session with Trisha and Charlotte scheduled for Oct 10.

tasks.name: Regulatory submission
tasks.notes: Prepare and submit regulatory dossier for scalp serum in US and EU markets. EU requires CPNP notification; US requires ingredient INCI listing review. Engage regulatory consultant. Target submissions by Jan 2027.

tasks.name: CommercePro to new platform data migration
tasks.notes: Execute full data migration from CommercePro to new enterprise e-commerce platform. Scope includes: customer records (~2.1M), order history (5 years), product catalog (180 SKUs), subscription data, and gift card balances. Validate data integrity post-migration.

tasks.name: QA checkout flow
tasks.notes: Complete end-to-end QA of checkout flow on new platform. Test all payment methods (credit card, PayPal, Shop Pay, Afterpay), promo code redemption, subscription checkout, and gift card application. Target: zero P1 bugs before go-live.

tasks.name: SEO redirect mapping
tasks.notes: Build comprehensive 301 redirect map from legacy CommercePro URLs to new platform URLs. Prioritize top 500 pages by organic traffic. Validate all redirects in staging environment. Coordinate with SEO agency (Rise at Seven) for impact assessment.

tasks.name: Update pro portal UI
tasks.notes: Redesign the Salon Professional portal UI. Key improvements: streamlined account registration, order history visibility, training resource library, and loyalty points dashboard. Work with UX designer on wireframes by Sep 25.

tasks.name: Sales deck refresh
tasks.notes: Refresh Salon Pro sales deck to include GlobalCorp acquisition context, updated product portfolio, new loyalty program tier structure, and Q4 2026 promotional offers. Must be ready for road show starting Oct 1.

tasks.name: Outreach to top 500 salon accounts
tasks.notes: Identify and prioritize top 500 salon accounts by revenue. Assign to regional reps for personalized outreach. Offer early access to relaunched Pro portal and Q4 incentive bonus. Target: 60% re-engagement rate by Nov 1.

tasks.name: HealthMart fall planogram submission
tasks.notes: Submit Q4 planogram to HealthMart buyer by Sep 20 deadline. Include No.3, No.4, No.5, No.8, and new No.9 Bond Protector. Provide shelf performance data for last 12 months and projected velocity for new SKU.

tasks.name: Target endcap proposal
tasks.notes: Develop holiday endcap proposal for Target. Must align with Target's Beauty category reset timeline (Nov 1). Include 4-foot endcap layout with gift sets and key hero SKUs. Coordinate with Target merchant and field team.

tasks.name: GlowCo Q4 promotional calendar
tasks.notes: Submit GlowCo Q4 promotional calendar including 21 Days of Beauty consideration, Black Friday event participation, and holiday gift set features. Coordinate with GlowCo merchant to confirm brand windows.

tasks.name: Reduce lead time on No.3 Hair Perfector
tasks.notes: Analyze current manufacturing and logistics lead time for No.3 Hair Perfector (currently 14 weeks). Identify top 3 reduction opportunities. Target: reduce to 10 weeks by Q1 2027. Key lever is moving secondary packaging in-house.

tasks.name: Audit 3PL fulfillment accuracy
tasks.notes: Conduct audit of primary 3PL partner (Radial) for DTC order fulfillment accuracy. Review pick/pack error rates, damage rates, and SLA compliance over last 6 months. Current accuracy rate is 97.2%; target is 99.5%.

tasks.name: Consolidate packaging suppliers
tasks.notes: Evaluate current packaging supplier base (12 suppliers) and identify consolidation opportunities. Target: reduce to 6-8 strategic suppliers by Q2 2027. Prioritize suppliers with dual US/EU capability to support GlobalCorp integration.

tasks.name: No.9 homepage hero banner design
tasks.notes: Design homepage hero banner for BondCare.com featuring No. 9 Bond Protector launch. Two versions needed: desktop (1440x600) and mobile (375x500). Animated and static versions for A/B test. Hand off to Ryan for implementation.

tasks.name: GlobalCorp IT security assessment
tasks.notes: Coordinate with GlobalCorp InfoSec team to complete security assessment of BondCare IT environment. Review access controls, data classification, and compliance posture. Deliverable: gap assessment report by Oct 31.

tasks.name: Holiday campaign creative brief
tasks.notes: Write and distribute the master creative brief for Holiday 2026 campaign. Must define campaign theme, visual direction, copy tone, channel guidance (social, email, OOH, in-store), and key dates. Brief due to agency by Sep 20.

tasks.name: Post-migration SEO performance monitoring
tasks.notes: Set up weekly SEO monitoring cadence post-migration. Track organic impressions, clicks, and rankings for top 100 keywords using Google Search Console and SEMrush. Alert threshold: >10% week-over-week traffic drop triggers escalation.

tasks.name: Innovation pipeline review with GlobalCorp R&D
tasks.notes: Joint session with GlobalCorp R&D and BondCare Product teams to review BondCare's 3-year innovation pipeline. Share roadmap for Scalp Serum, potential bond-building line extension, and sustainable packaging initiative. Confidential — NDA required.

tasks.name: HealthMart planogram data package
tasks.notes: Prepare supporting data package for HealthMart Q4 planogram submission. Include Nielsen scan data, loyalty basket analysis, and competitive share of shelf. Must be submitted alongside planogram file by Sep 20.

tasks.name: Salon loyalty tier restructure proposal
tasks.notes: Propose new tier structure for Salon Pro loyalty program: Silver, Gold, Platinum, Elite. Define spend thresholds, benefits per tier, and transition rules for existing members. Present to John and Charlotte for sign-off by Sep 30.

tasks.name: Ingredient INCI list audit for scalp serum
tasks.notes: Audit full INCI ingredient list for scalp serum formula candidates. Verify compliance with EU Cosmetics Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009, California Prop 65, and Credo Clean Standard. Flag any restricted ingredients for reformulation.

tasks.name: BeautyFirst co-op media brief sign-off
tasks.notes: Get sign-off from Charlotte and John on the BeautyFirst co-op media brief for No. 9 Bond Protector. Brief covers Beauty Insider email, SEO placements, BeautyFirst app push notification, and paid social amplification. Budget: $180,000.

tasks.name: Platform load testing pre-launch
tasks.notes: Conduct load testing on new e-commerce platform ahead of No. 9 launch traffic spike. Simulate 10,000 concurrent users. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks. Coordinate with platform vendor (Commercetools) on CDN configuration.

tasks.name: Supplier contract renegotiation — primary resin supplier
tasks.notes: Renegotiate annual contract with primary resin supplier for bottle production. Current contract expires Dec 31. Target: 8% cost reduction and minimum 60-day payment terms. Requires GlobalCorp procurement team involvement given new parent company leverage.

stories.text: Just got off the phone with the legal team — they want us to remove 'repairs 100% of breakage' from the claims list. Flagging for Sofia to address before the Sep 15 call.
Updated the claims list based on Marcus's note. Revised version attached. Key change: replaced the efficacy claim with 'visibly reduces breakage in 1 use' — waiting on legal sign-off now.
Studio is confirmed for Sep 22 — 8am-6pm at Milk Studios, NYC. I've shared the shot list with the photographer. Please review and flag any missing angles by EOD Sep 17.

GlobalCorp IT team pushed back the ERP workshop to Oct 3. Their EnterpriseOne migration team is tied up in a Germany rollout until end of September. Tom — can we use this time to finish the NetSuite module mapping?

Good call with GlobalCorp legal today. They've confirmed we can keep the BondCare name and brand identity fully independent — no co-branding required on consumer packaging. This is a win. Charlotte, I'll send you the meeting notes.
stories.task_name: Brand guidelines sync with GlobalCorp team

stories.text: Holiday packaging concepts from the agency are in! Three concepts shared in the linked Figma file. Concept B ('Luxe Gold') is my favorite — strong shelf presence. Let's review as a team by end of week.
Charlotte, can you confirm the holiday campaign theme before I write the email briefs? I don't want to start the Klaviyo builds until we have the creative direction locked.
Theme confirmed: 'The Art of Bond' — minimal, luxe aesthetic with copper/gold accents. Sofia, you're clear to start the email sequence. Creative assets from Marcus will be ready Oct 1.

Consumer research synthesis deck is looking strong. Key finding: 73% of respondents identified 'visible scalp flakiness' as their top concern — much higher than we expected. This validates our niacinamide + salicylic acid formula direction.

Data migration is blocked. CommercePro API rate limits are preventing us from extracting the full order history at the speed we need. Escalating to CommercePro enterprise support today. Ryan, let me know if you want me to loop in Commercetools too.
stories.task_name: CommercePro to new platform data migration

stories.text: Good news: CommercePro enterprise bumped our rate limit to 20 calls/sec. We should be able to complete the order history export by Sep 20. Updating the subtask accordingly.
stories.task_name: CommercePro to new platform data migration

stories.text: GlowCo Q4 promotional calendar submitted and confirmed! We're locked in for 21 Days of Beauty (Oct 12-31), Black Friday endcap, and a holiday gift guide feature. Great outcome — one of our best GlowCo agreements to date.

Radial audit report received. Overall fulfillment accuracy at 97.2% — below our 99.5% target. Top error categories: wrong unit count (42% of errors), damaged packaging at pick (31%), wrong variant selected (27%). Preparing corrective action plan.

Charlotte, I need your sign-off on the BeautyFirst co-op media brief this week. The $180K commitment needs to be approved before BeautyFirst's media planning deadline on Sep 19. Can we set up a 30-min review?

Load test results are in — platform handled 8,500 concurrent users before response times degraded. We need to optimize the product listing page queries before the No. 9 launch. Looping in Commercetools solutions architect for a call next week.

goals.name: Launch 2 new SKUs in Q4 2026
goals.notes: Successfully launch No. 9 Bond Protector and Holiday Gift Set collection across all key retail and DTC channels before December 1, 2026. Includes BeautyFirst, GlowCo, HealthMart, Target, and BondCare.com.

goals.name: Grow Salon Pro channel revenue 20% YoY
goals.notes: Grow the Salon Professional channel revenue by 20% year-over-year by end of FY2026 through program relaunch, top account outreach, and enhanced portal experience.

goals.name: Complete GlobalCorp Integration Milestone 1 by Q4 2026
goals.notes: Complete all Milestone 1 GlobalCorp integration workstreams by December 31, 2026. Milestone 1 covers: ERP assessment, legal entity review, brand guidelines, and supply chain documentation.

goals.name: Achieve $42M DTC e-commerce revenue in 2026
goals.notes: Drive $42M in DTC e-commerce revenue for full year 2026 through platform migration, improved conversion, and expanded digital marketing investment post-GlobalCorp acquisition.
